releaseNotes: HWM 0.2.5.6 STABLE promotion using the exact DEV and PILOT tested package. Service 0.2.5.5 provides the authenticated HWM Terminal fast channel over the existing /api/heartbeat transport, while preserving normal health, Headline Remote self healing and Mesh recovery behaviour. Tray 1.0.0.6 and Managed Updater 0.1.3.0 are unchanged. This STABLE promotion reuses the exact previously tested package without rebuilding.
